question:
**Select the word that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word. **

Cease
solution:
The correct answer is "**Begin**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the implication of the highlighted word:
 
• **Cease**: bring or** come to an end (**समाप्‍त होना या करना).
 
 
• Example: *The hostilities had **ceased **and normal life was resumed.*
 
 
 
• Let us understand the implication of the correct word:
 
• **Begin:** **start;** perform or undergo the **first part of (an action or activity) (**प्रारंभ, शुरुआत).
 
 
• Example:* Circuitry that Karen could not **begin** to comprehend.*
 
 
 
• It is apparent from the above explanation that "**Begin**" **is the opposite in meaning to "Cease"**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: ***Begin***
